value.rationale: Minimum zero-forcing cardinality alone misses the number and mobility of optimal seed placements. This natural infinite cubic circulant family has exactly seven structural optimal-set classes and a fully connected exchange graph. The coincidence of local statistics with the untwisted prism, yet distinct six-rung spectral moment, identifies a nontrivial topology-sensitive global feature. The result has broader scope than a finite census and does not rely on an unmotivated arbitrary slice.
